category: probability and stochastic processes / stochastic processes
canonical_claim: Let (X_i) be i.i.d. real random variables with mean zero and finite variance sigma squared, where sigma is positive. The continuous polygonal interpolation W_n on [0,1] of the normalized partial sums, with W_n(k/n) = (X_1 + ... + X_k)/(sigma * sqrt(n)), converges in distribution in C([0,1], R) with the uniform topology to standard Brownian motion as n tends to infinity.
